title: A customer's tier prices the same at every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use a staging client with two locations, location 1 and location 2, and a user who can work at both.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have two new work orders for this test for customer A, work order 1 at location 1 and work order 2 at location 2, each with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Switch to location 2.
  9. Open work order 2.
  10. Click Add Part under line 1.
  11. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  12. Type 1 in Qty.
  13. Pick category A in Category.
  14. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  15. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The part reads $121.50 at location 1 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).

Step 8:

  • Location 2 is the current location.

Step 9:

  • Work order 2 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 10:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 11:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 12:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 13:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 14:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 15:

  • The part reads $121.50 at location 2 too: $121.50 − $121.50 = $0.00 difference.
